package.description: Large-file transfer for creative teams — browser download links, file requests, and transfers and sync between computers and Synology NAS.

en-US.description: Large-file transfer for creative teams — browser download links, file requests, and transfers and sync between computers and Synology NAS.
en-US.longDescription:
WarpSend (warpsend.io): large-file transfer for creative teams — browser download links, file requests, and transfers and sync between computers and Synology NAS. Operated by Luxira Limited.

This package installs the WarpSend command-line tool and background agent for Windows on x64 and Arm64. To connect this PC, run `warpsend pair` and approve the one-time code in a browser signed in to WarpSend, then run `warpsend service install` from an Administrator terminal so the agent keeps running after a restart. The desktop app, with a system tray icon, is available from https://warpsend.io/download/.
en-US.name: WarpSend
